issue: The first scoped evidence commit normalized the captured stdout log CRLF to LF; the working-tree inventory had correctly bound the original raw stdout bytes.
resolution: Namespace-local *.log -text preserves the original captured bytes in Git. Re-add that one log under the attribute, update the final inventory to include this receipt and attribute, then authenticate every committed artifact byte.
closeout_owner: The implementing agent alone finalizes the inventory after all prior writers and this serialization receipt. No earlier quiescence is fabricated.
